scope: Current manuscript rendering, numerical integration and preservation checks; not a clinical-use certification

ige.scope: All aggregate IgE output CSVs regenerated from original patient records and fixed seeds

ablation.scope: All aggregate CSV files, exploratory formulas, and private held-out predictions were byte-identical on a clean re-execution of the component analysis. Source inputs and frozen primary files were not written.

scientific_boundaries: Matching inputs and patient folds were retained within each ablation population.
IgE imputation is a retrospective sensitivity analysis and never replaces observed values or prediction validation outcomes.
Molecular added EASI accuracy is not established across visits.
Abro 200 mg W24 IgE direction depends on missing-data assumptions.
Frozen equation lacks independent external validation; W24 is previously inspected same-cohort temporal application.
